name: hit_bone
for: a blow on bone (Keening Cage, gravecaller, skeletal foes, the Statue's cracked bone parts)
notes: A pale crack-flash, then bone chips and splinters thrown up and out that bounce and settle on the floor 74 px below the anchor, a puff of bone dust and drifting powder. Chips fade out on the last frames. 12 frames @ 12 fps.
